fields.summary: Cannot connect to VPN - license error
fields.description: Cannot connect to the corporate VPN: authentication succeeds but the gateway rejects the session with a license error. My laptop and network are unchanged since the last successful connection. Several people in my team face the same error. Please verify the license pool on the VPN gateway.

fields.summary: VPN license expired notification
fields.description: I get a notification that the VPN license has expired and the tunnel is not established. It worked normally yesterday and the client has not been updated. Other remote colleagues in Constanta report the same message. Please check the VPN gateway license status.

fields.summary: VPN client says license invalid
fields.description: Remote access VPN no longer works: the client shows 'license invalid or expired' right after authentication succeeds. Credentials and MFA are accepted, so the problem seems to be on the gateway side. Colleagues working remotely from Bucharest see the same message. Please check the VPN gateway licensing.

fields.summary: VPN license limit reached message
fields.description: The VPN client connects to the gateway but disconnects immediately with a message that the license limit has been reached. I retried several times and rebooted the laptop without success. I need remote access for work today. Please check the VPN gateway license pool and whether other users see the same message.

fields.summary: VPN activation error, license not available
fields.description: The VPN client reports that no license is available for this session and drops the connection. Working from home, I tried the mobile hotspot and my home network with the same result. Please check whether the VPN gateway has run out of licenses or the license has expired.

fields.summary: Weak wifi signal at my desk
fields.description: The Wi-Fi signal at my desk near the east windows is very weak and web pages load slowly. Moving two desks away fixes it. Please check coverage in this area.

fields.summary: Printer making noise
fields.description: The floor printer makes a loud grinding noise when printing double-sided pages, but the output is correct. Please have the device checked before it breaks.

fields.summary: Portal changes not visible
fields.description: I published an update on the department page of the internal portal but colleagues still see the old version, even after a hard refresh. Please check portal caching for this page.

fields.summary: Shared mailbox inaccessible
fields.description: I can no longer open the shared mailbox for customer invoices in Outlook, although it was added to my profile before. My own mailbox works normally. Please check my access to the shared mailbox.

fields.summary: [Network] Cloud apps disconnect constantly at the Iasi branch
fields.description: Cloud applications and Teams calls at the Iasi site disconnect repeatedly. The wired connection shows the same problem as Wi-Fi, and the connection recovers after a short time before failing again. The whole department is affected, which points to the site internet uplink rather than an individual device. Please check the WAN link and the provider.

fields.summary: Intermittent internet outage at Iasi site
fields.description: Internet access at the Iasi office is intermittent: it drops for about one to two minutes, returns, and then fails again. Internal servers are only reachable some of the time and VPN sessions to headquarters keep resetting. Several colleagues report the same repeated interruptions. Please check the site uplink and the network equipment for recurring loss of connectivity.

fields.summary: [Network] Iasi office offline every few minutes
fields.description: The Iasi office loses internet connectivity every few minutes. Everyone near my desk is affected and the laptop shows Wi-Fi as connected but without internet access each time it happens. Calls and cloud applications are unusable. Please check the WAN uplink, the edge router and the provider status for the Iasi site.

fields.summary: Internet connection keeps dropping at the Iasi office
fields.description: The internet connection at the Iasi office drops every few minutes for one or two minutes and then comes back. Teams calls disconnect and cloud applications time out during each drop. Colleagues on the same floor see the same behaviour, so this does not look like a single workstation problem. Please check the site WAN uplink and the edge router.

fields.summary: Internet connection unstable at our site
fields.description: Connectivity at the Iasi site is unstable. Web pages stop loading, Teams calls drop and the connection returns on its own after a short time. I tried another laptop and another network port with the same result. Please investigate the site network path and determine whether the fault is local or upstream.

fields.summary: Files stuck syncing
fields.description: The cloud storage sync client has shown 'syncing 14 files' for two days and some documents on my laptop are not updated. A restart of the client did not help. Please check the sync status for my account.

fields.summary: Poor print quality
fields.description: Pages from the printer next to our team room come out with grey vertical streaks. Replacing the paper did not help. Please check the toner and the drum of this printer.

fields.summary: ERP crashing with server errors
fields.description: ERP is failing during normal use: the application becomes unresponsive and then returns a server-side error (HTTP 500) when posting transactions. The failure blocks access to the finance module. Colleagues in other teams report the same errors. Please check the ERP application server and related logs and confirm whether other users are affected.

fields.summary: [ERP] ERP closed unexpectedly, application server not available
fields.description: The ERP client closes unexpectedly or shows 'application server not available' when I open the inventory module. Logging in again and using a different workstation do not help. The Oradea warehouse team cannot post goods receipts. Please check the ERP application server and its logs.

fields.summary: ERP unresponsive with intermittent server errors
fields.description: ERP is intermittently unresponsive and throws server-side errors when running reports and posting entries. It works for a few minutes and then fails again. The Cluj finance team is blocked from the daily close. Please check ERP application-server health and confirm whether the incident affects other sites.

fields.summary: ERP crashing on startup, server unavailable
fields.description: ERP fails to start properly: the login screen appears, but after authentication the application closes or reports that the server is unavailable. Colleagues in procurement and sales in Timisoara have the same problem. Please check the ERP application server and related logs.

fields.summary: ERP transactions failing with server error
fields.description: ERP transactions fail with a server error every time I try to save a purchase order. The application hangs for a minute and then reports that the server could not process the request. Several colleagues at the Timisoara office see the same error, so this does not look like a permission problem. Please check ERP application-server health.

fields.summary: Remote access VPN not working from coffee shop network
fields.description: While working from a coffee shop, the remote access VPN does not connect and ends with a timeout. Normal browsing works. The same laptop connects fine on my home network. Please suggest settings that work on public Wi-Fi.

fields.summary: VPN not working from airport network
fields.description: VPN does not work from the airport Wi-Fi. The client reaches the login step but the tunnel is never established. The connection works normally from the office and from home. Please advise on a workaround for restrictive public networks.

fields.summary: VPN fails on guest Wi-Fi at customer site
fields.description: I am at a customer site and the VPN fails on their guest Wi-Fi. The client reports that the gateway cannot be reached, while websites open normally. It works for me from the office network. Please check whether the VPN can be used over restrictive guest networks.

fields.summary: VPN fails on guest Wi-Fi
fields.description: The VPN client fails when I connect through the guest Wi-Fi of a partner office, with a timeout on the connection. Browsing works, only the VPN is blocked. Other colleagues connect without problems from their own networks. Please advise.

fields.summary: VPN blocked on hotel Wi-Fi
fields.description: I am travelling and the VPN client cannot connect from the hotel Wi-Fi: it stays on 'connecting' and then times out. The same laptop connects without problems from the office network and from my phone hotspot. Please advise whether another VPN protocol or port can be used.

fields.summary: Remote desktop over VPN unusable
fields.description: I can connect to the VPN, but remote desktop sessions to my office PC freeze after a minute. Browsing through the VPN works. Please check whether a firewall rule affects RDP for my account.

fields.summary: Mailbox full - cannot send email
fields.description: My mailbox is full and Outlook says I cannot send or receive new messages until I free up space. I have used 100% of my quota, mostly because of large attachments in the Sent Items folder. Nobody else in my team has this problem. Please increase my mailbox quota or advise how to clean it up.

fields.summary: Cannot send email - mailbox over quota
fields.description: I get a message that I cannot send email because my mailbox is over quota. I have used this mailbox for several years and the Deleted Items and Sent Items folders have grown very large. Please review my mailbox size and the configured limit.

fields.summary: Mailbox size limit reached
fields.description: Outlook reports that my mailbox size limit has been reached. I mainly receive large presentation files from customers, and the mailbox filled up after the last quarter-end. Please check my quota and let me know whether more space can be assigned.

fields.summary: Mailbox quota warning
fields.description: Outlook displays a warning that my mailbox is almost over quota. Most of the space is taken by an old archive of project attachments in my Inbox. Please tell me whether my quota can be increased or whether I should move older items to an archive.

fields.summary: Need larger mailbox
fields.description: My mailbox keeps running out of space and I have to delete messages almost every week. As I handle supplier correspondence with many attachments, I would like to request a larger mailbox quota. Please review my current limit and advise.

fields.summary: Missing ERP role after team change
fields.description: After moving to the procurement team last week I still cannot open the purchase order module. ERP reports 'Access denied: missing role ERP_PROC_APPROVER' although the role is expected for my position. Please verify my role mapping.

fields.summary: [Portal] Certificate error on internal portal
fields.description: The internal portal cannot be opened securely: the browser reports an invalid, expired certificate and blocks the page. The problem is present on several laptops in the Cluj office and on mobile devices as well. Please check and renew the portal certificate.

fields.summary: Browser says portal connection not private
fields.description: When opening the internal portal the browser shows a warning that the connection is not private and that the certificate has expired. I did not continue to the page. Other colleagues in Cluj see the same warning in Chrome and Edge. Please check the TLS certificate of the internal portal.

fields.summary: HTTPS error on internal portal
fields.description: Opening the internal portal returns an HTTPS error, 'NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID'. The same happens on a colleague's computer. Until this is fixed we cannot use the portal for approvals. Please check the portal TLS certificate and its expiry date.

fields.summary: Portal connection not private warning
fields.description: A 'your connection is not private' warning appears every time I open the internal portal, and the certificate details show that it has expired. This affects the whole team in Timisoara. Please renew or replace the certificate on the portal web server.

fields.summary: Cannot open internal portal - certificate error
fields.description: I cannot open the internal portal because the browser says the site's security certificate is not valid. Clearing the cache and trying another browser did not help. Colleagues at the Cluj office have the same problem. Please check the portal certificate.

fields.summary: Very high latency over VPN
fields.description: Over VPN, everything is very slow for me: file access takes ages and remote desktop lags, while colleagues on the same ISP have no issue. Please check my VPN profile and routing.

fields.summary: Wifi not working in meeting room
fields.description: Wi-Fi in meeting room B stops working during calls while the wired connection in the same room is fine. Other rooms on the floor are not affected. Please check the access point serving this room.

fields.summary: Cannot print to any printer in the Brasov office
fields.description: Printing is failing for the whole Brasov office. Every shared printer I try accepts the job but nothing is printed and the queue shows an error. Colleagues on my floor have the same problem on different printers, so this looks like a problem with the central print server rather than one device. Please check the Brasov print server and the spooler service.

fields.summary: Shared printers unavailable, spooler error in Brasov
fields.description: Shared printers in the Brasov office are unavailable: Windows reports that the print spooler service is not running on the server and jobs cannot be submitted. The whole floor is affected. Please check the Brasov print server and restore the spooler service.

fields.summary: Printing completely down at Brasov site
fields.description: Nobody in my team at the Brasov site can print. The printers are switched on, show no error on their display and scanning to email still works, but every print job fails. Several departments are affected at the same time. Please check the central print service for the site.

fields.summary: Print server not responding in Brasov
fields.description: The Brasov print server does not respond. Opening or adding any shared printer returns 'the RPC server is unavailable' and queued jobs are not released. Several users started seeing this at the same time and it affects all printers on the site. Please check the print server and the spooler service.

fields.summary: [Print] Print jobs stuck in queue at Brasov site
fields.description: Print jobs from my workstation stay in the queue with status 'Error' and never reach the printer. The same happens on the second-floor printers and the ones in the warehouse office. Other Brasov colleagues report identical behaviour. Please check the print server for the Brasov site and restart the spooler if necessary.

fields.summary: Cloud storage web interface not loading
fields.description: The cloud storage web interface stays on a blank page in my browser, while the desktop client works. I tried clearing the cache with no change. Please check whether my browser profile needs a reset.

fields.summary: Outlook add-in error after update
fields.description: After the latest Office update, Outlook shows an error about a COM add-in at startup and opens slowly. Safe Mode works without the error. Please check add-in compatibility with the new version.

fields.summary: SSO authentication failed on portal
fields.description: Single sign-on to the internal portal fails for my account with 'authentication failed', while other applications accept the same login. Please check my SSO profile.

fields.summary: Cannot open shared project folder
fields.description: I cannot open the shared folder of the Warehouse-Upgrade project: cloud storage says I do not have permission. My manager confirmed that I should have access. Please review my permissions on this folder.

fields.summary: Permission error on cloud folder
fields.description: Opening the Sales-EMEA folder in cloud storage returns a permission error. Other members of my team can open it without problems. Please check whether my account was added to the correct access group.

fields.summary: Access denied to shared folder
fields.description: I get 'access denied' when opening the Finance-Reports shared folder in cloud storage. I could open it before I changed teams last month. Please check my group membership and the permissions for this folder.

fields.summary: Lost access to team folder
fields.description: I lost access to our team folder in cloud storage and now get an access denied message. Everyone else in the team still sees the files. Please check what changed on my account and restore my access to the folder.

fields.summary: Permission error on cloud folder
fields.description: Cloud storage shows a permission error when I try to open the HR-Templates folder that I used last week. The folder owner says my account was removed from the group by mistake. Please restore my access.

fields.summary: Cannot export ERP report to Excel
fields.description: Exporting the monthly stock report from ERP to Excel creates an empty file. Other reports export normally. Please check the export template for this report.
